scripts.build: node tools/generate-typst-package.ts && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/dev-tools/tsconfig.json && vite build --config packages/dev-tools/vite.config.ts && tsc -p packages/workers/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/vite-react/tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p examples/vite-react/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p examples/pretext-hybrid/tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p examples/pretext-hybrid/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p packages/paramdoc-export/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/vite-app/tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p examples/vite-app/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p examples/vite-capture/tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p examples/vite-capture/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p examples/vite-library/tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p examples/vite-library/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/browser/tsconfig.json

scripts.pack:paramdoc-export: npm run build && npm pack --workspace packages/paramdoc-export --pack-destination .build
scripts.pack:workers: npm run build && npm pack --workspace packages/workers --pack-destination .build
scripts.pack:react: npm run build && npm pack --workspace packages/react --pack-destination .build
